subject: Hosted API evaluation: CartFlow sandbox + 30m demo
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@cartflow.io>
To: rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-04-15T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API evaluation: CartFlow sandbox + 30m demo

Hi Rachel,

I signed up via the self-serve flow for a Hosted API evaluation (CartFlow). We're kicking off a small pilot to evaluate embeddings + generation latency for chat summarization. Can we do a 30-minute walkthrough this week? I included a short note on our goals below.

Goals:
- Validate generation latency for 512-token replies on p99
- Try embeddings for semantic search of 10M product docs
- Confirm data handling + retention settings for sandbox traffic

We're flexible but prefer late-morning Pacific. Happy to use your Calendly.

Also — can you provision sandbox creds ahead of the session so our engineer can pair during the demo?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Integrations, CartFlow
alex@cartflow.io

Cc: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com

Alex — thanks for signing up and the clear goals, really helpful. I can run the 30m walkthrough and get sandbox credentials provisioned before the call.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Thu 4/15 11:30am–12:00pm PT
- Thu 4/15 1:30pm–2:00pm PT
- Fri 4/16 10:00am–10:30am PT

Pick whichever works best and I’ll send a calendar invite. I attached a short preflight checklist that covers test data, sample prompts, and a small latency probe we like to run (hostedapi-preflight-checklist.pdf).

If any of these conflict, Diego (cc'd) handles the SDR autorescheduling flow and can propose additional options. I can also preload a sandbox account at https://sandbox.redwoodinference.com/cartflow/creds once the time is confirmed.

Link to book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-rk/30min-hostedapi-eval

Quick ask: please confirm whether you want embeddings + generation in the same slot (we can do both, but mixing adds a little setup time).

Best,
Rachel Kim
SDR, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: hostedapi-preflight-checklist.pdf (1 page)
